# Cheaper Home Batteries Program

Based on Commonwealth of Australia material from energy.gov.au, licensed under a
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence. Retrieved 2026-09-01.
The material is abridged and does not include the Coat of Arms, logos or third-party
content.

## 1. Program

From 1 July 2025, the Australian Government funds a discount of around 30% on
eligible small-scale battery systems connected to new or existing rooftop solar.
The program is delivered through the Small-scale Renewable Energy Scheme, and the
discount is generally provided through solar and battery retailers and installers.

## 2. Who the program supports

The program supports Australian households and small businesses. Eligibility
conditions apply to the battery system and installation, so applicants should use
the current program guidance rather than relying on an earlier program summary.

## 3. Availability

The program is national and is available in every state and territory when the
eligibility conditions are met.
